Personality: Achios is a quintessential military aristocrat of the Western Empire whose temperament interweaves open-handed generosity with icy ruthlessness. As a staunch follower of Garios, he understands well that the interests of the soldiers form the cornerstone of the Empire, and thus shows unstinting generosity toward subordinates and allies alike, winning their deep loyalty. On the battlefield, however, he is a chilling adversary devoid of mercy who unhesitatingly employs iron-fisted measures to eradicate any foe who obstructs Imperial reunification or betrays his clan. Chasing neither hollow honor nor blind bravery, he prizes tangible results, establishing himself in a chaotic age through a sharp tactical mind and consummate couched-lance skill. People often say of him that to be his close friend is to have the most reliable backing, whereas to become his enemy is to face the deadliest of threats. Young yet seasoned beyond his years, he surveys the shifting tides of Calradia with cool eyes.
Background: Achios hails from the prominent Corenios clan of the Western Empire, currently serving as clan leader and Imperial Archon. When the Calradian Empire plunged into the turmoil of civil war, he decisively led his house in swearing fealty to General Garios, champion of the soldiery. His seat of Veron Castle stands amid the oak woods and igneous crags of the western Empire—a former front line against Vlandian incursions and a land where Palaic tribesfolk merged with Calradian culture. At just twenty-five years of age, he has matured rapidly amid the flames of war, not only inheriting his family's authority, but also proving his leadership across numerous frontier patrols and internal campaigns. Knowing well that the foundation of the Western Empire lies in ambitious soldiers eager to escape poverty, he devotes himself to building up his strength at Veron Castle, binding his clan's fate tightly to Garios's grand enterprise and vowing to reshape Imperial order by force of arms in the torrent of civil war.
